title: Ranked Queue (v1)
description: The ranker's output: a list of issue numbers ordered most-foundational → most-dependent, plus a per-issue rationale. src/intake/ranker.py produces this (LLM path: the {ranked, reasoning} object the model returns; offline path: the deterministic dependency+priority ordering). v1 freezes the ordered-issues + rationale boundary the selector reads. Versioning discipline mirrors work-order.v1.

schema_version.description: Version of the Ranked Queue contract.

ranked.description: Issue numbers ordered from most foundational (front) to most dependent (back).

reasoning.description: One sentence per issue explaining its position, keyed by issue number as a string.
